text:
Mia Chen: quick thought — can we annotate saved queries with developer conversation snippets so product teams can see why a filter existed?
Ashok Patel: interesting. you mean like a small note linked to a saved view that surfaces in the console timeline? :thinking_face:
Mia Chen: yep. tiny, optional annotations. want them searchable and tied to telemetry (who opened, when, diff in routes used).
Tess Rivera: +1 UX-wise. could be a hover preview on per-route/per-model cards. avoids users digging into audit logs.
Samir Gupta: implementation question — do we store annotation as part of savedquery object or as separate telemetry event? pros/cons: single object = simpler to fetch; separate event = better audit/history.
Ashok Patel: separate event feels right for immutability. we can attach event_id to savedquery metadata for quick lookup. also helps with rollbacks.
Nora (UX): for discoverability, we should show "latest convo" and let teams opt into a small timeline panel on the insights view. mock attached? (will post in Figma)
Mia Chen: search requirements: full text search + filter by author + link to model/route snapshot. we need tokenized telemetry index.
Samir Gupta: API shape proposal: POST /api/saved_queries/:id/annotations { text, author, snapshot_id? } returns annotation_id. GET /api/saved_queries/:id/annotations -> list.
Ashok Patel: + add headers for route_id and model_id so routing policy and quota context included. also include `telemetry_context` blob for replayability.
Tess Rivera: can we keep preview length to ~140 chars by default and show full in panel? mobile needs compact too.
Mia Chen: deployment plan: start as opt-in flag per-tenant. private customers might want annotations disabled or routed through gated KMS for PII.
Samir Gupta: storage: small text + references -> store in events DB (append-only). add derived table for latest_annotation per saved_query for quick render.
Ashok Patel: telemetry side — we should also emit metric when annotation is created/edited: `saved_query.annotation.created` with tags {route, model, tenant}. useful for rollout signal.
Nora (UX): for console, show a subtle badge on saved queries with a speech bubble icon; clicking opens inline thread. keep reactions (emoji) not full comments to avoid heavy moderation.
Mia Chen: security: treat annotation text as user content. escape HTML, scan for secrets by default, and surface moderation flag if needed.
Samir Gupta: rollout checklist: API + events DB + derived view + console badge + search indexing. I can spike the events DB schema.
Ashok Patel: quantify cost — indexing cost and read QPS. if high-traffic savedqueries get annotated a lot, we need caching TTL for preview.
Tess Rivera: UX probe: show to 5 teams first (platform, infra, growth), gather qualitative notes on usefulness.
Mia Chen: sounds good. Nora will post mocks. Samir + Ashok to propose API & schema PRs by EOD Friday. I’ll own rollout plan and product notes. :rocket:
deploy-bot: deployment scheduled: staging/ui/2026-04-02T03:00Z -> success
Nora (UX): posted Figma link: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/annotations-prototype — comments welcome
Ashok Patel: one more: ensure annotation creation respects saved query ACLs. only editors should annotate unless team setting permits comments.
Mia Chen: approved. thanks everyone — will sync after the spikes.
